name: quillmesh-companion
description: A live, local-first Markdown collaboration bridge between Codex and QuillMesh.

interface.shortDescription: Live context, reviewed Diff edits, conflict protection, and exports.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the active QuillMesh document and selection, open exact sections, diagnose formulas, tables, quotes, and images, review edits as a Diff in QuillMesh, preserve revision conflicts, refresh the editor after accepted writes, and export PDF, PNG, HTML, or Word.
defaultPrompt: Read my current QuillMesh selection and suggest an edit.
Check this document's formulas, tables, quotes, and image paths.
Show this edit as a Diff in QuillMesh before writing.
